previous_description: Named information asset subject to fine-grained access rights and data classification. Represents a logical grouping of data (e.g., customer PII, financial records) whose access is governed by associated InformationRight grants and AccountabilityRequirements, per NIST SP 800-53 AC-3 and IP-1.
definition: A named logical category of information (e.g. customer PII, payment card data, medical records) defined independently of where or how it is stored, which carries a sensitivity classification and is the object to which InformationRights grant actors access. It names *what* the data is, not the endpoint, table or field that holds it.

distinguish_from.when: the protected thing is a concrete technical artefact (an API endpoint, database table, file store, service or UI) with operations performed on it, rather than a storage-independent category of data.
you are modelling the classification scheme itself (levels, encryption obligations) rather than a specific data category that is assigned one of those levels.
the control applies to one named field and its masking or redaction strategy, rather than to a whole logical grouping of data that may span many fields and stores.

standard_reference: STS-ml Information entity; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 RA-2 (Security Categorization) and AC-3 (Access Enforcement)
code_evidence: A data inventory, record-of-processing (ROPA) or data-catalog document listing named data categories such as 'Customer PII' or 'Cardholder Data', each with a sensitivity level.
An enum or constant set of data categories (e.g. DataCategory.PII, DataCategory.PHI, DataCategory.PCI) referenced by authorization checks or masking logic across several classes.

Marker annotations or catalog tags (e.g. @PersonalData(category="contact"), BigQuery policy tags, AWS Macie or Purview classifications) applied consistently to fields in multiple models or tables to group them into one asset.

attribute_descriptions.name: description
attribute_descriptions.description: Free-text explanation of what data this information asset comprises (example fields, data subjects, and systems where it appears); set it whenever the entity name alone does not make the boundary of the asset clear.

notes: IP-1 is a Rev. 3 Appendix J control, superseded by the PT family in Rev. 5, so the definition reference should be updated. classification is a free string that duplicates the DataClassification enum and the constrained-by relationship; make it an enum or a reference. authorizationRequirements duplicates the bidirectional governs relationships with InformationRight.
